record_body:
ACCOUNT SUMMARY
- Regulated workload prospect (healthcare software; PHI-adjacent data). Strong preference for Redwood Private in customer VPC; public hosted API likely non-starter except for non-prod evaluation.
- Current path: procurement + security review in progress; customer counsel focused on how usage is measured (tokens/requests/streaming), rounding, retries/failed requests, dispute window, and audit rights.

FIRMOGRAPHICS / DEPLOYMENT
- HQ: US (NA). US-only data processing required.
- Target deployment: Private in customer VPC (their AWS org). Wants customer-managed networking + private endpoints; no public ingress.
- Key integrations requested: customer-managed KMS key for encryption, SSO/SAML for console access, audit logs export to their SIEM.
- Retention: wants ability to configure prompt/response retention to 0 (or short retention) and keep only aggregated usage metrics.

USE CASE DETAILS
1) Clinical document search + summarization
   - Mix of embeddings + reranking + chat summarization. Notes: "we need citations / traceability" (they will handle source citations, but want stable model versions).
2) Internal support-agent for ops teams
   - Latency sensitivity moderate; reliability + auditability high.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS (NOTES)
- Throughput: initial pilot ~50-100 RPS across embeddings + chat; expects 3-5x within 6 months if rollout succeeds.
- Model stance: prefers pinned model version + controlled upgrades; asked about fallback behavior when capacity constrained.
- Observability: wants per-route cost/latency breakdown; needs mapping between console usage view and invoice line items.

PROCUREMENT / LEGAL TIMELINE
- 2026-01-10: Intro + qualification; confirmed VPC requirement and that hosted is only acceptable for sandbox.
- 2026-01-24: Security questionnaire received; they flagged "audit logging" and "data residency" as must-haves.
- 2026-02-06: Legal/procurement call (see Fireflies ff_8c21d4a0). Counsel asked for specific measurement language + dispute process.
- 2026-02-12: Sent draft clause language + references; customer returned redlines asking:
  - Dispute window: requested 90 days (our standard is shorter).
  - Audit rights: requested ability to audit metering methodology beyond invoice support artifacts.
  - Failed requests/retries: wants explicit statement that failed requests are not billed (or billed only for tokens actually generated/returned).
- 2026-02-21: Customer asked for an "example invoice" and a worked example showing token totals for a streaming request that ends early.

BILLING / METERING QUESTIONS (VERBATIM / PARAPHRASE)
- "If the client disconnects mid-stream, do we pay for tokens generated after disconnect?"
- "How do you count retries? If our client retries due to a timeout, are we double-billed?"
- "Is rounding per request or at the invoice level? We need the console to match the invoice within a tight tolerance."
- "Can you show the raw telemetry fields you use to calculate billed tokens?"
- "In a Private/VPC deployment, what is the source of truth for usage: our logs, your control plane, or both?"

COMMERCIAL NOTES
- Expectation: enterprise commitment structure preferred (predictable spend) but wants usage-based transparency and reconciliation capability.
- Interest in Dedicated GPU pools in VPC if required for isolation + predictable latency.
- Pricing sensitivity: moderate; more concerned about defensible measurement + internal chargeback.

INTERNAL OWNER NOTES / ACTIONS
- Engage Legal (Michael Grant / Sofia Mendes) for final stance on dispute window + audit scope. Use approved "metering/measurement" guidance and avoid promising broader audit rights than standard.
- Provide a metering walkthrough deck: definitions (input/output tokens, embeddings units, rerank units), edge cases (streaming partials, retries, caching/batching), and how invoice line items map to dimensions (model/region/endpoint).
- Set up technical architecture review: Ethan Park to cover Private control plane integration + VPC networking + KMS.
- Flag to Finance (Laura Bennett / Emily Stone) that customer will likely require reconciliation support during first 1-2 invoice cycles; propose adding them to early anomaly monitoring once live.

NEXT STEPS (CUSTOMER-FACING)
- Send: (1) VPC/Private deployment overview + security controls list, (2) approved measurement & billing clause language, (3) worked examples for streaming disconnect, retries, and rounding/aggregation.
- Schedule: 60-min metering + invoice reconciliation walkthrough with customer finance ops + counsel (target by end of Feb).

RISKS
- If we cannot meet their requested dispute window / audit wording, deal may slip to April cycle.
- They are benchmarking against Azure OpenAI private connectivity; need crisp differentiation on auditability + consistent console/invoice alignment.

LINKS / ARTIFACTS
- Fireflies: ff_8c21d4a0 (procurement + metering measurement questions)
- Gmail threads: thread_2d9a10fe44 (legal redlines), thread_5a7713d0b2 (counsel Qs on audit/dispute)
- References: metering language guidance + invoice line item mapping + hosted API meter definitions + packaging guidance (see linked docs in record)
